title: fix(grove): the idle check counts every live crew, and an idle box still sleeps
description:
# the grove idle check counts every live crew, and an idle box still sleeps

twin of uladkasach/dev-env-setup#214, for `provision/aws.infra/account=camp/grove/genGroveHibernatorUserData.ts`.

## the defect
the first-boot idle check reads brain traces only under `/home/<user>/.claude/projects`
(`GROVE_BRAIN_TRACES_DEFAULT`). fleet clones write theirs under each worktree, at
`.agent/.actors/*/brain/.claude/projects`, so a box at work reads idle and hibernates under its
crews. its runs also log `sort: write failed: Broken pipe`.

## the fix, as shipped in #214
- read activity, not presence: every worktree actor trace root, each live tmux pane (a registered duct), and pts input reads
- an unreadable source holds the box and fails loud; it never reads as idle
- no `sort | head` pipe under pipefail: the newest stamp is a single-pass max

## the clamp
dev-env-setup `.play/permanent/prove.idle-check-clamp-bites-the-legacy-check.play.sh` runs every
world of `prove.idle-check-counts-every-crew` against any check named by `IDLE_CHECK=<path>`.
point it at the check userdata renders: red before the fix, green after.

## owed here
render the same check from userdata (or install it from the bundle `1.15.hibernate`), and prove it
with the clamp via `IDLE_CHECK`. note: dev-env-setup#203 lets a hetzner box provision as a grove;
the stop act is ec2-only, so a non-ec2 platform must decline the act, never call aws.
